retired.lesson: Escalating is a write. The test asserted called == [] on a malformed triage result, so the fixed escalation (inbound:unknown + needs-human, dequeue) was planned and discarded and the item re-triaged every 15 minutes (#670). The rule it meant to encode, that the MODEL'S classification never reaches gh, is kept; the escalation carries nothing the model said and is written to the issue the workflow named.
